wholePhysicalScope: The photographed Palace-Council House of September 2010, with its white west façade, four rounded corner turrets, crenellated parapets, entrance canopy and east bay.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the crenellated palace, round corner turrets, west steps and east bay. Near levels show recessed lancets, crenel coping, canopy posts and mast frames.
limitations: The two cleared Qualla photos control the west façade. Rear windows, parapet subdivision, lantern frames and roof equipment are interpreted from available evidence.
The national BAG/AHN main roof is approximately 15.15 m above the measured ground. The lidar data constrain massing and are not historic survey control.
This model depicts the palace building and its immediate connecting bay. The separate later civic-office complex lies outside its scope.
Terrain contact is approximate. Independent public elevation tiles were sampled before modeling and the source field is unchanged.
Reference photographs are retained in the Qualla corpus with their exact file hashes recorded here.
